title: Santa Fe Schools Move Forward With New Cybersecurity Policy
content_md: André Salkin reports: The Santa Fe school board approved a new cybersecurity policy this week but delayed a vote on a separate policy governing student data privacy, with most board members calling it too broad and too important to rush through.
